summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments, specifically addressing a Codecov configuration issue flagging the api-client package for having 0% test coverage against a 70% target.
summary.outcome: Fixed the Codecov configuration to mark the api-client coverage check as informational rather than blocking, committed and pushed the change, and resolved the single unresolved review thread.

repo: The api-client package (~120 files) is entirely generated code and intentionally has no tests — coverage targets should not apply to it.
The repo has a .planning/ directory (~19 files) and .learnings/ directory (~5 files) that are excluded from file count limits.
A recent commit reduced tracked file count from 265 to ~125 by excluding packages/api-client/**, .planning/**, .learnings/**, and apps/web/src/api/**.

code.finding: api-client target was set to 70% coverage but the package is generated code with no tests; changed to informational to prevent blocking CI.

workflow: Use GraphQL reviewThreads query to fetch unresolved PR threads before triaging.
When replying to PR comments via REST API, use --field (not -f) for in_reply_to since it must be an integer.
Resolve PR review threads via GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread after replying.

friction: Codecov's default behavior of blocking PRs for packages with no tests (generated code) requires explicit configuration workarounds.
open_items: With ~125 files now tracked, there is still headroom before the 150-file limit — worth monitoring as the repo grows.
The api-client package coverage is now informational only; if non-generated code is ever added to that package, the coverage target should be revisited.
